guides.favoredWhen: Patient Double Up angles with your support; never duel her range.

keyTips.text: Never duel her range. She pokes you down from outside your reply, so win through Double Up ({cd:21:Q}) bounce angles from far away, not through trades.
Slow her with Make It Rain ({cd:21:E}) and take only short trades with your support. Extended fights and solo trades belong to her.
Track her 90 Caliber Net ({cd:51:E}) and Flash. She keeps disengage ready before trading, so engage only when both are down.

tips.text: Be patient and farm with Q bounces off the wave while she holds her net. Forcing plays into her ready disengage is how this lane is lost.
Punish when her net is down. That is the only window your short trades win, so call your support the moment she spends it.
Position outside her auto range when going for last hits. Every free poke she lands without an answer is the lane slipping toward her.
Group skirmishes around your support, where waves meet and bounce angles appear. Alone in a side lane you have no setup and she picks you apart.
Hold your slow for her overextensions. When she steps up to poke, land Make It Rain and take the short support trade before she disengages.
Take only short supported trades in fights, never the long poke war. Her range wins every extended exchange, so force quick engages and leave.
Collapse her range with numbers. She dies once locked down without her net, so bring your support or jungler to the fight she wants to take alone.

itemization.text: Your gold comes from patient Q-farm, not kills. Base on clean crashes and keep your support's tempo instead of forcing buys for a duel you cannot win yet.

keyTips.text: Stage a low-health minion so Q bounces through it onto the champion as a repeatable poke pattern.
Cast E before R so its slow makes Bullet Time connect more easily.
Poke before longer trades; she loses sustained races to most attack-speed ADCs, so all-in only for finishes.

tips.text: Drop E between self and pursuers on ganks to slow their approach.
While ahead, zone opponents off last hits and punish every farming step forward.
Enter objective fights on a safe R angle, never channeling where opponents focus easily.
Make space with E and slow pursuers, repositioning fully before committing to Bullet Time.
Hold extra distance from assassins and divers because your low mobility leaves you vulnerable.
Hunt multi-target Bullet Time that flips fights, connecting the channel through the E slow.
Threaten high burst from outside attack range with a prepared Q bounce off a low minion.
Snowball safe leads by zoning the enemy duo and banking damage before any all-in.
Respect R positioning always: it turns fights but punishes every exposed channel.
